trap.label: ideia principal
trap.wrong: The paragraph A is about the effect from the neighbourhood.
trap.right: Paragraph A is about the effect of the neighbourhood.
trap.why: O brasileiro usa “efeito de/da” com from ou omite o artigo. Em inglês: the effect of X (on Y).

mcq.q: Para achar a ideia principal, leia…
Paragraph A is about the effect ___ the neighbourhood.

fix.wrong: The effect from noise is clear.
fix.right: The effect of noise is clear.
Noise has an effect on sleep.

rewrite.answer: Noise has an effect on sleep.

rewrite.prompt: Use the effect of: “The neighbourhood affects children.” (The effect…)
rewrite.answer: The effect of the neighbourhood on children is clear.
